classifications.reason: The admitting clause describes the low-power, small-engine vehicles that the jurisdiction classes as mopeds, matching the class contract.

Neither commercial mass classification nor commercial licensing guarantees that every admitted vehicle has the two or three wheels required by ru.moped.
